author: Arendeth

description: Finishes classes the game left unfinished. Where a tree ends in a "* NYI *" placeholder, this fills it and adds strong capstone skills after the normal ones, up to the skills screen's nine slots. Off by default: turn it on for the extra skills, off for the trees as the game shipped them (a character keeps its ranks either way). Every placeholder tier in the game becomes a skill: the Cybertechnician's jamming spine, a colossus form for the Force Psyker, a Boltron foreman for the Engineer, credits that cheat death for the Smuggler, chems with strange side effects, a gun that fires once per two rounds loaded, and more.
